scenarios.title: Domain registration
scenarios.gate: the account's File Provider domain registers and appears in Finder's sidebar

probes.name: domain-present
probes.purpose: the GramDrive provider domain is registered with the system
probes.detail: GramDrive File Provider domain is registered — command exit 124

probes.name: domain-log
probes.purpose: capture the domain reconcile/repair log (com.reluxworks.gramdrive / file-provider-domains)
probes.detail: capture the domain reconcile/repair log (com.reluxworks.gramdrive / file-provider-domains)

manual_checks.name: sidebar-entry
manual_checks.action: open Finder after authorizing the test account
manual_checks.expected: a GramDrive location for the account appears under Locations in the sidebar

scenarios.title: Enumeration (dataless placeholders)
scenarios.gate: Finder shows the chat tree as stable dataless placeholders, no content hydrated by browsing

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

probes.name: cloudstorage-root
probes.purpose: list the File Provider mount root and its dataless markers
probes.detail: list the File Provider mount root and its dataless markers

manual_checks.name: tree-visible
manual_checks.action: browse the GramDrive location down to a chat folder
manual_checks.expected: the Account/Main/<chat> tree renders; message/media items show as not-yet-downloaded (cloud/download badge), and browsing downloads nothing

manual_checks.name: no-eager-hydrate
manual_checks.action: watch the download indicator while scrolling a large chat folder
manual_checks.expected: no file starts downloading merely from being listed (SYNC-040)

scenarios.title: Hydration of a dataless file
scenarios.gate: opening a dataless file streams the correct bytes and promotes it atomically

probes.name: pre-open-dataless
probes.purpose: placeholder: operator records `stat -f '%Sf' <file>` before opening to show the dataless flag; captured in the evidence form
probes.detail: placeholder: operator records `stat -f '%Sf' <file>` before opening to show the dataless flag; captured in the evidence form

probes.name: hydration-log
probes.purpose: capture the full GramDrive unified log for this window (com.reluxworks.gramdrive, all categories)
probes.detail: capture the full GramDrive unified log for this window (com.reluxworks.gramdrive, all categories)

manual_checks.name: open-file
manual_checks.action: double-click a known dataless media file (e.g. a fixture image)
manual_checks.expected: it downloads, opens, and its bytes/size match the known fixture (SYNC-042 atomic promote)

manual_checks.name: materialized-after
manual_checks.action: check the file's Finder badge after it opens
manual_checks.expected: the file now shows as downloaded/materialized, not a placeholder

scenarios.title: Cancellation of an in-flight hydration
scenarios.gate: cancelling a download stops promptly and leaves the item safely dataless, not corrupt

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-after-cancel
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

probes.name: cancel-log
probes.purpose: capture the full GramDrive unified log for this window (com.reluxworks.gramdrive, all categories)
probes.detail: capture the full GramDrive unified log for this window (com.reluxworks.gramdrive, all categories)

manual_checks.name: cancel-download
manual_checks.action: start downloading a large file, then cancel it from Finder's progress UI
manual_checks.expected: the download stops promptly; no partial file is presented as complete

manual_checks.name: reopen-after-cancel
manual_checks.action: open the same file again after cancelling
manual_checks.expected: it hydrates cleanly from scratch (resumable/disposable state, SYNC-043)

scenarios.title: Offline pinning
scenarios.gate: pinning keeps content offline; it survives eviction pressure

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-pins
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

manual_checks.name: keep-downloaded
manual_checks.action: right-click a materialized file and choose "Keep Downloaded" (pin)

manual_checks.name: pin-survives
manual_checks.action: trigger cache pressure / eviction (or the companion's evict action) and re-check the pinned file
manual_checks.expected: the pinned file stays materialized while unpinned content may evict (SYNC-051)

scenarios.title: Title/order change keeps stable identity
scenarios.gate: a chat title/order change updates the appearance without breaking item identity

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-before-update
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

manual_checks.name: rename-observed
manual_checks.action: change the chat's Telegram title (or its dialog order) and let the change sync
manual_checks.expected: the Finder folder's display name/position updates to match

manual_checks.name: identity-stable

manual_checks.expected: the file is still materialized/pinned — its identity did not change (SYNC-026/045)

scenarios.title: Provider / app process restart
scenarios.gate: after a provider/app restart Finder shows stable placeholders and materialized state persists

probes.name: agent-launchctl
probes.purpose: capture the companion agent's launchd state before/after restart
probes.detail: capture the companion agent's launchd state before/after restart

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-after-restart
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

manual_checks.name: restart-provider
manual_checks.action: quit and relaunch GramDrive (or reboot); reopen the GramDrive location in Finder
manual_checks.expected: the same chat tree and stable placeholders reappear (identity survives restart, SYNC-004)

manual_checks.name: materialized-persists

manual_checks.expected: it is still materialized/pinned; no re-download of already-local content

scenarios.title: User-triggered domain repair
scenarios.gate: the companion "Repair File Provider Domains" action rebuilds provider state without data loss

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-before-repair
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

probes.name: repair-log
probes.purpose: capture the domain reconcile/repair log (com.reluxworks.gramdrive / file-provider-domains)
probes.detail: capture the domain reconcile/repair log (com.reluxworks.gramdrive / file-provider-domains)

manual_checks.name: run-repair
manual_checks.action: invoke the companion menu action "Repair File Provider Domains…"
manual_checks.expected: a lost account domain is re-registered and recovers its existing Finder state; strays are cleaned with downloads preserved (SYNC-071)

manual_checks.name: no-total-teardown
manual_checks.action: observe repair when the canonical account set reads empty while a domain is still registered
manual_checks.expected: repair refuses the total teardown and leaves domains in place (TotalTeardownPolicy.refuse)

scenarios.title: In-place upgrade

probes.name: app-version-before
probes.purpose: record the installed app version before the upgrade
probes.detail: record the installed app version before the upgrade

probes.name: fileproviderctl-dump-before-upgrade
probes.purpose: capture current File Provider domain + item state
probes.detail: capture current File Provider domain + item state

manual_checks.name: install-over
manual_checks.action: install the newer signed build over the existing one and relaunch
manual_checks.expected: the app upgrades; the launch reconcile re-registers the same domains without wiping Finder state

manual_checks.name: state-survives-upgrade
manual_checks.action: check domains, pins, and materialized files after the upgrade
manual_checks.expected: all survive; any DB/schema migration is transactional/resumable (NFR-013/SYNC-072)
